definitions.explanation: The period before a war. In Japanese without further specification, this almost always refers to the period before World War II, particularly the era before Japan's defeat in 1945.

examples.japanese: {戦前|せんぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{違|ちが}っていた→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{戦前|せんぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{建|た}てられた→建てる：01189_tateru⟧。
examples.english: This building was built before the war.

examples.japanese: {戦前|せんぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are major differences between the prewar and postwar education systems.

notes:
USAGE:
When used without qualification, {戦前|せんぜん} almost always refers to the period before World War II in Japan (before 1945). Used as a noun and as a modifier ({戦前|せんぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧). Often contrasted with ⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧ (postwar) and {戦中|せんちゅう} (wartime).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {戦前|せんぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧: prewar Japan
- {戦前|せんぜん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: since before the war

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧: postwar (after the war)
- {戦中|せんちゅう}: during the war, wartime
